Planting for clay soil

Posted by Sam

Clay is heavy, but it is rich. Most of the gardens we design in Leeds sit on it, and the plants that love it will outgrow anything on sand.

Plants that thrive

  • Hardy geraniums, which flower from June to the frosts
  • Asters for late colour
  • Roses, which adore the moisture

Read our pond guide next, or book a visit. A planting plan costs £150.
